name: The Gärten
notes: All 4 photos were legible printed menus at 5322 Banks Street. Photos 1-2 (a clean digital scan) and 3 (a physical photo of the same laminated card, near-identical prices) all show the 'Pizza Cassette' menu; photo 4 shows a differently-branded 'The Pizza Tracks' menu at the same address with different items/prices. Both are included, sections tagged by menu name to avoid conflating identical section headers with different item lists. Skipped the 'Pizza in a Pan' +10 upcharge as a modifier, not a dish.
